description: A report object provides supplemental information about a report

cardKey.description: Used to override the default cardKey, which is the cardKey of the card, in which the report macro is used

identifier.description: The identifier of the planned evidence

template.description: The template of the planned evidence. If it is not given, no button is shown

buttonLabel.description: The label of the button that creates the evidence

hint.description: A text that tells where the evidence is, when there is no template

title: Report
